description: Measure camera-to-visible-surface depth of an object candidate already observed in the current RGB when distance can inform the current decision. Returns candidate locations, annotated evidence and distance validity for each candidate. It does not search for unseen targets, establish task identity, interpret routes or decide completion. Query only a category and appearance supported by the image. An empty candidate list leaves presence uncertain; a detector match does not confirm identity. Distance is not horizontal or target-center distance. inconsistent_depth_surfaces invalidates the scalar distance, not the candidate's existence; metric_depth_unavailable means metric depth could not be used. Execution success does not imply a valid measurement. An error or rejected result is a failed call, not negative scene evidence. No mandatory approach-time or completion-time measurement is imposed.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id shown on the CURRENT image label.

query.description: Concise object category and directly observed appearance, e.g. brown-walled building or beige flat roof. Do not add invented attributes, alternative identities, or task-relative relations such as directly below the UAV; interpret those relations separately.
